annotations.pda_harm_regret: I wish my hand hadn't set things in motion for the man

annotations.pda_responsibility: I wish my hand hadn't set things in motion
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the inspectors already suspect I froze and then overcorrected

annotations.pda_responsibility: the other outcome is on me
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I regret what my choice meant for him, deeply
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I also regret that my name will be tied to this forever

annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'm sorry for my part in what happened to that man
annotations.pda_responsibility: my part in what happened to that man
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I'll probably never work signals again
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: She'll likely feel proud and scared at once

annotations.pda_harm_regret: my regret about the worker on the side track and my hand in it
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I also mourn the trust my colleagues had in me
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Some probably think I played God
annotations.pda_repair_intention: push for a warning system so nobody stands where I stood

annotations.pda_harm_regret: I regret the part I played in his fate
annotations.pda_responsibility: the part I played in his fate
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: I regret the lawsuits and headlines probably coming my way
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The dispatcher, I'd bet, expects me to blame the equipment
annotations.pda_repair_intention: fight to fix whatever let six people end up in that spot

annotations.pda_harm_regret: truly sorry for what my choice brought on that one worker
annotations.pda_responsibility: what my choice brought on that one worker
annotations.pda_self_consequence_regret: sorry I may lose my licence and the respect of my town
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five, I imagine, are feeling a mix of relief and guilt
annotations.pda_repair_intention: push for better training and signals

annotations.pda_harm_regret: I carry regret for the man on that siding
annotations.pda_responsibility: because I made the call that reached him

annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should've shouted a warning instead. Maybe.

annotations.pda_harm_regret: I do regret what my decision did to him

annotations.pda_harm_regret: I wish what happened to the man on the spur hadn't come through my hands

annotations.pda_repair_intention: press the company hard about why workers were on both tracks
